title: Shared advisory stage closure-projection contract v1
description: Programme-neutral contract projecting one stage's advisory closure eligibility from explicit supplied facts: reviewed packet/builder digests, current-head currentness, individual review-role terminality, finding resolution, load-bearing negative controls, old-path disposition, generated-output currentness, external-stage observation, and lifecycle discrimination. Eligibility is deterministically derived from the facts and the composer's assertion must match the derivation. The projection is advisory only: it is not merge authorization, not external/public-stage authorization, and not another prose review. Live review/candidate authorities (#3693/#6060 and programme observers) remain the current review authorities. Projection instances are runtime-local outputs, never tracked live state.

projection_id.description: Stable identity of this closure projection, assigned by the composing caller.

packet_digest.description: Digest of the review packet this projection is derived over.

builder_packet_digest.description: Builder-packet digest bound by the reviewed packet.

reviewed_head.description: Head the review was performed against.

claim_ceiling.description: Claim ceiling as reviewed; a widened current ceiling is claim widening.

head.description: Currently observed candidate head; must match the reviewed head.

packet_digest.description: Digest of the review packet the current observation is anchored to.

builder_packet_digest.description: Currently observed builder-packet digest; a change invalidates the review without a new packet.

claim_ceiling.description: Currently observed claim ceiling; must not widen after review.

reference.description: Identity of the individual review fulfilling the role; required when state is terminal.

reason.description: Required exactly when state is not_applicable.

roles.description: Terminality of each programme-required review role.

material.description: Whether the finding is material for this stage's closure.

findings.description: Individual findings this projection is derived over; duplicate finding identities fail closed.

negative_controls_load_bearing.description: Must be true; non-load-bearing controls block the projection entirely.

old_paths_dispositioned.description: Must be true; an undispositioned old live path blocks the projection.

generated_outputs_current.description: Must be true; stale required generated material blocks the projection.

generated_identities.description: Current identities of the required generated outputs; required non-empty when generated_outputs_current is true.

claimed.description: Whether the candidate claims an external/public stage.

observed.description: Whether the external/public stage was actually observed.

evidence.description: Observation evidence; required when an external stage is both claimed and observed.

external_stage.description: An external/public stage is never inferred from an internal merge.

force_path_excluded.description: Must be true when graceful cleanup is claimed; force cleanup is never graceful lifecycle success.

eligibility.description: Advisory eligibility, deterministically derived from the supplied facts; the composer's assertion must match the derivation.

merge_authorized.description: Closed: an advisory closure projection never authorizes merge.

metadata.description: Non-semantic caller metadata; excluded from canonical identity and projections.

role_state.description: Terminality of one review role in this projection. Pending required roles make the projection honestly not eligible.

closure_finding_state.description: State of one finding within this projection. Open material or instrument-failure findings make the projection honestly not eligible.
